results.content: Among racial groups, white Idahoans, who make up the large majority of the state's population, approve at 51 percent and disapprove at 40 percent. Black Idahoans approve at 33 percent and disapprove at 67 percent. Hispanic and Latino residents approve at 45 percent and disapprove at 51 percent. Those identifying as another race approve at 44 percent and disapprove at 50 percent. [...] Civiqs, a nonpartisan online polling firm that surveys presidential approval on a rolling basis, puts Trump's current approval in Idaho at 49 percent, with 41 percent disapproving as of Thursday.
